purpose: Exercise composition, controls, source completeness and failure reporting with equal finite budgets. These visible prompts cannot substantiate an unseen-test claim.

cases.prompt: Create an original low-poly tidal observatory with a rotating beacon, orbit and zoom controls, reset camera, and resize support. Use only the pinned Three.js core module in a complete HTML file.

Create an original floating seed archive with three connected greenhouse islands. Show distinct footbridges and a central gathering place. Include orbit, zoom and reset controls, a stable initial camera, and reduced-motion behavior in one HTML file.
Create a compact mechanical clockwork garden. Keep all gears visually separated, expose pause and reset controls, and keep the object count bounded. Use procedural geometry and no physics engine.

Create an accessible moon-base courtyard on a laptop viewport. Keep the landmark visible after resizing to a narrow viewport and provide keyboard camera controls. Do not fetch textures or import addons.

acceptance: Track syntax, render, interaction and visual results separately. Preserve failures and repairs. A static render is not a playable game.
